name: Hotel Pont Royal
positioning: Literary Left Bank hotel in Saint-Germain-des-Prés, between the Seine and Boulevard Saint-Germain, with warm wood interiors and a jazz bar
best_for: Travelers who want a Left Bank base steps from Saint-Germain's literary cafes and galleries
Families wanting a suite with a sofa bed or a two-bedroom terrace suite

facts.text: The hotel sits on the Left Bank, between the Seine and Boulevard Saint-Germain.
The hotel is steps away from the literary cafes and art galleries of Saint-Germain-des-Prés.
The neighbourhood is the Paris that inspired Hemingway, Sartre and Simone de Beauvoir.
Saint-Germain-des-Prés keeps a quiet, residential atmosphere while offering convenient access to the city's major cultural attractions.
The hotel is wrapped in warm wood tones with an intimate atmosphere.
The rooms and suites are light-filled.
Guests have direct access to L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon.
Every month the hotel's lounges host literary dinners, orchestrated by journalist and writer Olivier Barrot, where an author and guests talk about the author's work over a gastronomic dinner.
Until 4 January 2027 the hotel hosts the exhibition Collection Parisienne by Aurélie Clérault.
Each Junior Suite has a living area with a sofa bed for two children under the age of 12.

highlights.text: Bar F-Sharp hosts intimate live jazz every Monday, Thursday and Saturday evening.
Depending on their location and orientation, certain room categories offer a view of the Eiffel Tower.
Rooms look out over Parisian rooftops.
The flagship family accommodation is the 2-Bedroom Panoramic Terrace Suite, designed for up to 5 guests.

considerations.text: Only certain room categories, depending on location and orientation, have an Eiffel Tower view.
Booking L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon in advance is recommended; hotel staff can make the reservation.
WhataHotel notes smaller room sizes typical of historic Paris properties.
